column1: # Awards shows and categories that build-awards.ps1 reads from Wikipedia's ceremony pages.
# Add a line to add a category; no code changes are needed, and the app shows whatever
# categories awards.json lists. Only these categories are collected, not every award.
# [shows]       id <TAB> name <TAB> short name <TAB> ceremony page title ({n} = 1st, 2nd...) <TAB> year of the 1st ceremony
# [categories]  id <TAB> show id <TAB> name shown in the app <TAB> match <TAB> people?
#   match   how the category is recognized on a ceremony page, separated by |: the
#           Wikipedia article its heading links to (redirects are followed), or the
#           heading's exact text for years when the heading has no usable link
#   people  yes = also list the nominated people (director, actor...), no = the film is the nominee
# Lines are shown in this order within each show.
